column1: # shards.tsv — the langspec corpus split into CI shards, one line per
# (shards_test.go) keeps it complete and disjoint; `make test-langspec
# SHARD=n` runs one shard and the ci.yml matrix runs them in parallel.
# Tests that share a memoised walk (gatherCensus: TestCompiledCoverage,
# two TestSpecProd*) stay together so the walk runs once. Balanced greedily
# on the wall clock of a verbose full run on 2026-09-17 (1652 s under
# concurrent load; about 410 s per shard); rebalance when one shard drifts
# past the others by more than a minute — `go test ./langspec -v` gives
